title: IRS exempt organizations, via ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer
notes: Built on the IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File, served through ProPublica's Nonprofit Explorer API. No key required, and it is the authoritative registry rather than a scraped directory.

NTEE W30 is Military and Veterans Organizations. It is the cleanest filter but NOT a complete one: many Veteran-serving charities file under P (human services), L (housing), or F (mental health), so a keyword pass runs alongside it.
hasFilings is the activity signal. The BMF is full of registered shells that have never filed a 990, and publishing those would pad the directory with organizations a Veteran cannot actually reach.
Monthly is the right cadence. The BMF updates monthly and nonprofit status changes slowly.
This is a large source. The 25 minute timeout and 700 request budget are deliberate, and it runs in its own process so a slow run blocks nothing else.
